fields.label: Active
fields.description: Unticking retires this step without deleting it or the history of coaches who already completed it - it just stops being created for anyone newly starting onboarding.

fields.label: Stage Sort Order
fields.description: Stages are displayed in this order (ascending) - stage name alone doesn't sort correctly (e.g. "Stage 10" would sort before "Stage 2").

fields.label: Where It Happens
fields.description: e.g. LMS, Frappe, External, In-Person, Manual, Background

fields.label: Link URL
fields.description: Where the "Go" action on this step should send the coach - an LMS course, a document to sign, etc. Leave blank for a step with no specific destination.

fields.label: LMS Chapter Title
fields.description: Exact title of the matching chapter in the LMS course editor (e.g. "Access your emails with Chantelle Venter"). When set, the Go link and Done status for this step are worked out automatically from the coach's actual progress through that chapter's lessons, instead of using Link URL / needing anyone to mark it done by hand. Set together with LMS Course via the franchisor Onboarding page's Manage Step List chapter picker, not typed here directly.

fields.label: LMS Course
fields.description: Which LMS course LMS Chapter Title belongs to - disambiguates two chapters that happen to share a title in different courses. Set automatically by the Manage Step List chapter picker.

fields.label: LMS Lesson Number
fields.description: Which lesson within the chapter Go should open (its position in the chapter's lesson list, not the lesson's own name) - Done still requires every lesson in the chapter, not just this one. Set automatically by the Manage Step List lesson picker.

fields.label: Depends On
fields.description: Optional - if set, this step shows as locked for a coach until the step it depends on is marked Done.
